basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost at its plant in Braga and put the improvements in place?

sub_questions.question: What is the current conversion cost per part at the Braga plant, and where does it arise?
Which improvements would lower cost per part the most, and by how much?
How are the approved improvements put in place and running on the plant floor?
Is conversion cost per part down by a measurable amount against the baseline?
Can the plant team keep the improvements running once the engagement ends?

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: One site diagnosed on the floor in 2 to 3 weeks, framed by a start-up week and a synthesis week.

work.unit: Pilot site: changes made and savings shown in the cost data

phase_work.why: One plant is the pilot site, so no rollout wave follows; initiatives, results tracking and capability building run side by side.

sizing.levers: A narrower first set of initiatives, limited to the largest cost items found in the Diagnostic, would shorten Implementation most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost per part at the Braga plant and size the improvements that would lower it.

gate.label: Initiative go/no-go
gate.decision: Which initiatives go ahead to implementation at the plant, and which are dropped?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Put the approved improvements in place at the plant and show the cost-per-part reduction in the cost data.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Is the final result approved, with the improvements running at the plant?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: 13 to 16 weeks is an estimate built from the work; settle it before quoting.
Implementation uses the middle of an 8 to 12 week estimate; slow plant changes or late cost data would push it toward 12 weeks.
No Measurement or Handover phase: results tracking and the plant team's takeover can sit inside Implementation; confirm no separate post-launch tracking is wanted.
